key_highlights: ASX lifted by miners and tech following Wall Street bounce despite big tech jitters
Australian unemployment climbs to 5-year high, hammering AUD and curbing RBA rate hike expectations
Housing market risks escalate as Sydney auction clearance rates slump and price falls accelerate
Junior iron ore producers face margin squeeze amid soft pricing, while gold and critical minerals advance

sectors.trend: Bifurcation between resilient gold/rare earths developers and struggling iron ore juniors facing severe cost pressures.
sectors.implications: Favor low-cost majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) and producers fast-tracking gold over marginal iron ore juniors.

sectors.trend: Weakening labor market and accelerating Sydney property downturn threaten bank net interest margins and loan quality.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit risk and moderating credit growth create headwinds for major mortgage lenders (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: ASX tech tracked overnight US gains, but sentiment remains fragile due to high valuations and AI revenue scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Near-term volatility for tech heavyweights (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) despite index-level support.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas supply imbalances and structural market strains continue to impact energy utilities and producers.
sectors.implications: Regulatory risk and supply volatility weigh on producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX).

sectors.trend: Consumer spending under pressure from rising unemployment alongside regulatory scrutiny over surcharges and governance.
sectors.implications: Selective pressure on discretionary retailers (SUL.AX, WES.AX) as consumer confidence weakens.

sectors.trend: Residential property correction deepens, but plateauing RBA rate expectations provide valuation support to commercial REITs.
sectors.implications: Cautious stance on residential developers; potential bottoming for defensive prime commercial assets (SCG.AX, DXS.AX).

key_themes: Labor market inflection: 5-year high unemployment softens RBA tightening bias while weakening domestic demand
Currency depreciation: AUD slump on weak labor data boosts unhedged offshore earnings but increases import cost pressures
Resource divergence: Gold and critical minerals advance while junior iron ore miners face severe margin pressure
Housing market correction: Accelerated Sydney property declines elevate systemic credit and banking risks

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight exposed residential developers and reduce exposure to high-LVR bank mortgage books.
Maintain exposure to cash flow-resilient resource majors and inflation-hedged defensive infrastructure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron Ore Junior Insolvency & Price Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid high-cost, single-asset junior iron ore miners; stick to tier-one producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).
Hedge high-multiple domestic tech positions; prioritize companies with proven free cash flow.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Tier-1 Diversified Miners and Gold Producers
opportunities.rationale: Weaker AUD/USD enhances local currency revenues for diversified resource exporters, while gold momentum remains strong.
USD-earning healthcare majors benefit directly from AUD depreciation and offer shelter from domestic macroeconomic softening.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Domestic Lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising unemployment and falling Sydney property values raise risk of bad debts and compress credit growth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Broad Index Downside via Index Overlays
defensive_moves.rationale: Diverging macroeconomic signals and overseas tech fragility warrant downside protection on the ASX 200.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading between 8,100 and 8,350 as mining strength counters banking and housing headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Moderate upside potential supported by eventual RBA policy easing, contingent on China commodity demand stabilization.
key_catalysts: Next RBA monetary policy statement and official cash rate decision
